crossRefs.note: For the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil. Some have been led astray from the faith in their greed, and have…
from which things some, having missed the mark, have turned away to vain talking,
holding faith and a good conscience, which some having thrust away made a shipwreck concerning the faith,
men who have erred concerning the truth, saying that the resurrection is already past, and overthrowing the faith of…
For the law, having a shadow of the good to come, not the very image of the things, can never with the same sacrifices…
to all who are in Rome, beloved of God, called to be saints: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord…
And the God of peace will quickly crush Satan under your feet. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.
The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all! Amen.
The Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Grace be with you. Amen.
All who are with me greet you. Greet those who love us in faith. Grace be with you all. Amen.
Grace be with you all. Amen.
Bring us not into temptation, but deliver us from the evil one. For yours is the Kingdom, the power, and the glory…
